Staying Alive: Map Awareness for Beginners

Dying less is the fastest way to win more. Learn the habits that keep you alive: watching the minimap, tracking missing enemies, and knowing when to back off.

Why deaths cost so much

Every death gives the enemy 300 gold or more and some experience. While you're dead (10 seconds early, up to over a minute late in the game), your minions die without you, so you lose farm and XP too. And your team plays 4 versus 5.

New players often lose not because they're bad at fighting but because they die to things they could have seen coming.

The minimap habit

Look at the minimap every 3 to 5 seconds. It feels unnatural at first, so tie it to something you already do: after every last hit, or every time you use an ability. Check:

  • Where is the enemy jungler?
  • Is my lane opponent still in lane?
  • Are several enemies grouped somewhere?
Pro tipIf you see the enemy jungler on the opposite side of the map, you're safe for about 20 to 30 seconds. That's a great time to play aggressively.

Missing enemies

When an enemy disappears into the fog of war, ask where they could be going. If your lane opponent leaves and you can't see them, they might be heading to another lane (a roam). Ping them as missing so your teammates know.

When you can't see the enemy jungler and you're pushed far forward, assume they're nearby. The further you are from your tower, the more danger you're in.

Common mistakeChasing a low-health enemy deep into their side of the map. That's exactly where their jungler and teammates are. Many deaths start with "I almost had him".

When to back off

  • You're low on health or mana. Recall instead of risking it.
  • Your opponent just hit level 2 or 6 before you. They have a new ability and you don't.
  • The enemy's minion wave is much bigger than yours. Minions hurt a lot early; don't fight inside a big enemy wave.
  • Several enemies are missing. Play near your tower until you see them again.
  • Your Flash is on cooldown. You have no escape, so play safer.

Using your tower

Your tower is your safe zone in the early game. It hits enemy champions very hard, so enemies only attack you under it if they're sure they can kill you quickly. If you're being chased, run toward your tower. If you're low, stay near it and farm with abilities from a distance.

Later in the game, towers get weaker relative to champions, and enemy teams can kill you under them more easily.

Learn from your deaths

Every time you die, ask one question: "What could I have seen or done earlier to avoid this?" Usually the answer is one of: I didn't look at the minimap, I didn't have vision, I fought without my abilities, or I chased too far. Fixing one of these at a time makes a huge difference.

Key takeaways

  • Each death gives the enemy gold and costs you farm and XP.
  • Check the minimap every 3-5 seconds; tie it to your last hits.
  • Ping missing enemies, and play safe when you can't see the jungler.
  • Back off when you're low, behind on levels, outnumbered, or without Flash.
  • After each death, ask what you could have seen earlier.
